hardware.proposed_role: Compact initial hardware target if development access is available
limitations: Board capacity and timing closure must be established for the selected core.
Published 4 ns timestamp resolution does not establish sub-nanosecond measurement accuracy.
FDK, tool licensing, board revision and procurement remain access gates.

hardware.device: Select exact SKU and revision before estimating resource or timing margins
limitations: A larger resource budget does not establish a lower PHY or pipeline latency.
Clock, transceiver, MAC, shell and license configuration are part of the result.

hardware.proposed_role: Specialized low-latency research platform after the portable design works
limitations: Device capability is not an Apex_Tick performance result.
Device IP, board access, tool support, measurement instrument and commercial terms must be confirmed.

hardware.proposed_role: Partner-funded feasibility and later silicon path
limitations: No performance prediction from process-node or DUV/EUV labels alone.
Require qualified macro/PDK, tool access, corner analysis, package and die-boundary costs.
NRE, verification, physical design, yield, test and deployment volumes determine economics.
A simulated or placed-and-routed design remains distinct from measured silicon.

libraries.name: Corundum
limitations: Interface clock domain and exact RTL revision must be pinned.
A NIC framework does not supply a verified exchange strategy or session.

libraries.name: Taxi
limitations: Verify implemented components, license obligations and board support at the pinned revision.
Do not infer a production TCP session from an Ethernet component.

libraries.name: DPDK
limitations: PMD, NIC SKU, hugepages, queue placement and polling CPU are part of configuration.
Apex_ULL real DPDK backend currently rejects initialization.

libraries.name: AF_XDP
limitations: Copy and zero-copy are distinct modes.
Driver capabilities and actual activated mode must be measured and recorded.

libraries.name: Onload
limitations: Record NIC, driver and supported acceleration path.
A library install does not establish real accelerated traffic.

libraries.name: Aeron
limitations: Reliable transport, buffering, backpressure and publication/subscription semantics differ from raw packet I/O.

libraries.name: DuckDB
limitations: SQL/dataset equivalents do not automatically meet licensed STAC-M3 specifications.

libraries.name: vLLM / TensorRT-LLM
limitations: Pin model, precision, quality, cache and batching.
No inference runner is duplicated in Atlas.

process_and_package.policy: Record process and exposure metadata per layer when documented; it is not a predictor of trading latency.

cost_model.missing_cost_policy: Unknown remains null, never zero. Public output may show authorized ranges rather than restricted quotes.
cost_model.expected_outage_cost: annual_incident_rate * mean_hours_per_incident * loss_per_hour; alternatively use annual downtime fraction * hours_per_year * loss_per_hour, with the different meaning recorded
cost_model.npv: -initial_investment + sum(discounted_incremental_cashflow_t) + discounted_residual_value; no double counting of amortization and initial cash investment
cost_model.payback: first period when cumulative net cashflow becomes nonnegative, with interpolation policy recorded; unknown if business cashflow is unknown
cost_model.asic_break_even: NRE / (FPGA_fully_loaded_unit_cost - ASIC_fully_loaded_unit_cost), only for positive denominator and comparable functionality; capacity and risk assumptions remain separate
cost_model.energy_per_operation: average_power_W / completed_operations_per_second gives J/op; report baseline system power and measurement boundary
colocation_benefits: Record physical distance, connection path and operational access only when documented.
Do not assign unmeasured queue priority, profit or nanosecond value to a colocation perk.

limitations: The catalogue covers named public families; premium metrics and specifications are not accessible here.
Hardware and library integrations are candidates, not implemented backends.
Vendor timing, internal simulation and external results remain distinct.
No claim to exceed all STAC benchmarks or to predict contract revenue.
